card_name: HDFC Diners Club Black Credit Card
fee_details:
- Rs.10,000 + 18% GST (Joining Fee)
- Rs. 10,000 +18% GST (Renewal Fee)
reward_structure:
Get 5 reward Points for every Rs.150 spent.
Earn 10X Reward Points on all partner brands.
You can earn 2X reward points on weekend dining spends
You get 2X reward points when on weekend dining spends
key_highlights:
- Complimentary game access at golf courses in India and abroad.
- Annual membership of Amazon Prime, Club Marriott, Forbes, Times Prime, MMT BLACK, Swiggy One on a complimentary basis.
- Get complimentary annual features of Club Marriott, Forbes, MMT black, Taj etc worth up to Rs 80,000

benefits_features.Travel benefits:
You can book air tickets, bus tickets, and train reservations across 350 airlines and hotels (International as well as domestic).
You can redeem reward points for booking air tickets or making train reservations across a variety of options (International as well as domestic).
You have unlimited access to 1,000+ airport lounge access globally. The access is complimentary for primary as well as add-on cardholders.
benefits_features.Fuel benefits: Get a 5% value-net fuel surcharge on transactions over Rs.500.
benefits_features.Lifestyle benefits:
You get complimentary Golf access at golf courses in the world.
You get 6 rounds every year quarter.
You get discounts at partner spas, salons, wellness retreats, and gyms.
benefits_features.Wellness benefits: You get discounts at partner spas, salons, wellness retreats, and gyms.
benefits_features.Welcome benefits: You receive complimentary annual memberships from Club Marriott, Forbes, Amazon Prime, MMT BLACK, Swiggy One, and Times Prime.
benefits_features.Annual benefits:
You receive complimentary annual memberships of Club Marriott, Forbes, Amazon Prime, MMT BLACK, Swiggy One, and Times Prime once you spend Rs.8 Lakh within 12 months from the date on which the card was issued.
From 1 February 2023 onwards, One complimentary membership will be offered as an annual reward instead of Direct Passport, Freelance Direct, Passport Plus or more information.
benefits_features.Monthly milestone benefits: Whether you are a new HDFC Bank Diners Club Black Credit Card holder or an existing holder, you can choose any two monthly vouchers from Taj, Cult.fit, or BookMyShow or Ola Select Membership worth Rs. 500 per month provided you spend Rs.8,000.

how_tos.How to Apply HDFC Diners Club Black Cred: You can apply for HDFC Diners Club Black credit card online. Apart from submitting your application, you can upload the required documents too. This ensures that your card application is processed faster.

reward_point_benefits:

- You get 2X reward points when on weekend dining spends

fees_and_charges.Payment return charge: 2% of the payment amount (Minimum of Rs.450)

miscellaneous:
Eligibility Criteria for HDFC Diners Club Black Credit Card:
Employment status: Salaried or Self Employed
Age: 23 years to 60 years (for salaried applicants)
23 years to 60 years (for self-employed applicants)
Income: Net monthly income more than Rs.75,000 (for salaried applicants)
Minimum Tax Return of Rs.60.21 Lakh per annum (for self-employed applicants)

faqs.Can I earn reward points on the amount t: Yes, you can earn reward points on the amount that you spend using your HDFC Bank Diners Club Black Credit Card.
faqs.Where can I get details about the golf c: You can get details about the golf courses that you can visit using your HDFC Diners Club Black card.
faqs.Where can I get more details about the H: You can get more information about the HDFC Bank Diners Club Black credit card. You can also contact HDFC Bank's customer care at 1800 266 4322 to get information related to the credit card.
faqs.Within how many days will I receive my b: If you fulfill the basic eligibility criteria, then you will receive the benefits associated within 30 days of the issuance of the card.
faqs.How will I know if I have any reward poi: The bank will inform you by sending you an SMS or an email whenever you have any points and will also help you with the process of redeeming those benefits.
